payload.posture: Read 2 Thessalonians 1:6–12 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states affliction and relief are placed before the Lord’s appearing. For it is a righteous thing with God to repay affliction to those who afflict you, that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
